The office wall art refers to art prints chosen specifically to personalise and inspire a workspace — whether that is a corporate office, a home study, or a creative studio. This set of 3 Paris street café illustrations brings a travel-inspired, illustrative style to your wall, featuring charming Haussmann buildings, cosy café fronts, and the Eiffel Tower rendered in a warm beige, white, black and bordeaux palette. Office wall art is a simple, affordable way to make a workspace feel less generic and more like your own, boosting mood and focus throughout the working day. Unlike purely decorative pieces, well-chosen office art reflects your personality and can even act as a quiet source of daily inspiration.

How to Choose and Hang the Office Wall Art — a Simple Step-by-Step

1. Measure your wall space first: Before ordering, measure the width of the wall or the furniture your prints will hang above (desk, shelves, filing cabinet). Aim for the total width of your three prints to cover roughly two-thirds of that space for a balanced look.

2. Pick your size: Use the size-guide image below the product to see how each size looks in a real office setting. Smaller sizes suit compact desks or narrow walls; larger sizes make more impact in open-plan or generously sized rooms.

4. Decide on framed or unframed: If you want zero hassle, choose a framed or canvas-wrapped option — it arrives ready to hang. If you prefer to source your own frame to match existing décor, go unframed.

5. Hang in a straight row at eye level: Position all three prints at the same height — centre point around 145–150 cm from the floor — with a consistent gap of 5–8 cm between each one. Use a spirit level for a crisp, professional result.
